title: Command performance for Eisenhower and Zhukov in Hamburg
summary: From Nancy, France, she was taken to Hamburg to entertain Eisenhower and Marshal Zhukov at the command headquarters.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Oh, don't let me forget now during that war is when I did that command performance for Eisenhower.

See, because I was -- I had my troop in Nancy, France. And they -- they wired the publicity man, whoever it was, and told him to get me, because there were a lot of USO shows in different vicinities around then, but they wanted me, wanted my show.
And they took me from Nancy, France, to Hamburg, Germany, to the command headquarters, and there's where I
entertained General Eisenhower, Marshall Zukov -- when they -- Zukov presented Eisenhower with that medal -- that's where it was, at the command headquarters in Hamburg. See?
